description: Exchange pause in the watchlist row (Android RowPause.kt / iOS RowPause.swift). shownUntil: pause end shown instead of the normal time line («Binance · paused until 19:45»), given the stored pause end pausedInMillis relative to now (null = no pause) and whether the pair is disabled; expected relative to now, null = normal time line. Same plausibility limit as ExchangeBackoff.isPaused (at most 6 h ahead). pauses: stored backoff states per exchange -> pause end per exchange (states without a pause end are left out).

shownUntil.name: more than 6 h ahead: implausible (clock set back)

pauses.name: only exchanges with a pause end
